title: Full pinned ZKIR v3 and native ledger capability inventory

target.capabilityBoundary: Full safe source representation of coherent capabilities in pinned native ZKIR v3, together with native ledger composition. Compact 0.36.1, language 0.28, is a minimum comparison only.
target.versionEvidence: IrSource::load accepts major 3 and minors 0 through 2. The pinned VM dispatch does not branch on the minor-version field. These are source-inspection facts rather than a new cross-version acceptance run.

auditMethod.enumExtraction: Top-level Instruction and IrType variants extracted from exact pinned source and compared to all rows. Source order retained for binary-layout review.
auditMethod.meaningOfCounts: Enum and requirement coverage only. These counts do not measure completion, enumerate every overload or constitute an executable conformance corpus.
auditMethod.existingEvidence: Three previously executed 3.2.1 workload records seed native keygen, checker, proof and ledger observations. Membership in a successful workload does not qualify an operation independently.
auditMethod.scopeLimit: Public networks and whole-language safety remain unqualified. The included Agda draft predates expanded types and instructions.
auditMethod.sourceObservation: The Nightlean working tree was read during concurrent bounded-scalar implementation. Source and test definitions are observations, without newly executed scalar proof or ledger results.

E-NATIVE321-CLAIM.scope: actual Lean Native/Bool claim, typed Native encodings, always-active Impact groups, empty explicit outputs
E-NATIVE321-CLAIM.negativeEvidence: Five changed witnesses rejected by checker. Replay host guard rejected against fetched spent state. No replay transaction submitted.
E-NATIVE321-CLAIM.privacyEvidence: No general disclosure analysis or private-dependent activity proof

E-RAW321-BOOL.scope: Four positive and six negative raw Native eight-bit and Native 0/1 scenarios. No IrType::Bool, IrType::Byte or Lean deserialization feature is exercised.

E-RAW321-JUBJUB.scope: Native input 7 produces an intermediate JubjubScalar and generator point, self-equality and empty output. This supplies no independent curve vector or source Jubjub feature.
E-RAW321-JUBJUB.regression: Native 3.2.0 keygen exits 101 with a missing Jubjub chip. Tagged 3.2.1 keygen succeeds at k=10, 684 rows.

E-LOCAL-SOURCE.scope: Working tree includes concurrent bounded-scalar work. Read as lowering/test definitions, not a new proof or ledger result.

E-UPSTREAM-TEST-DEFINITIONS.scope: Upstream proof, typed-output and chip-inference tests are definitions only. Not executed or credited as Nightlean acceptance.
